description: This file defines the DefaultMessageConfig class, which is an immutable implementation of the MessageConfig interface. It manages configuration settings related to message timeouts within a gateway service, specifically default and maximum timeout durations. The class provides a factory method for creating instances based on external configuration data and overrides standard Object methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMessageConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MessageConfig handling message timeout configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method creating an instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default message timeout duration.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum message timeout duration.
